scope: Bounded northern and remote access-pathway pass. Local access, regional hubs, destination care, travel, funding and return-home continuity remain distinct facts.

notes: Existing NIHB, Hope for Wellness, Ontario Indigenous treatment-directory and provincial intake records were not duplicated.
No fixed-site withdrawal facility was inferred for Churchill, remote Manitoba First Nations, Nunavut communities or Labrador communities.
Nunavut health-centre contacts are regionalized; no single phone is represented as the local number for every community.
Rural Atlantic additions enrich provincial/regional pathways instead of cloning a program into each municipality.

navigation_pathway.destination_service: Regional staff confirm the destination, itinerary, boarding home and approved escort arrangements.
navigation_pathway.transportation_pathway: Regional staff book approved flights, accommodation and some ground transport.
navigation_pathway.funding_pathway: Coverage and escort approval depend on current territorial and NIHB rules.
return_home_support: Regional travel staff arrange the return itinerary.
Follow up with the home-community health care provider after returning.
